selection: Union of all three previously tested sets; no replacement, exclusion or support-based selection.
task: Original JAR; declared entry / response JSON path / original source boundary; concrete invocation, object, field/element and observed version; data origins exclude selector/control origins.

inputs.ordinary: Six existing fixture structures: multi-record, equal-value, single, empty, more, repeated. Shared across tools with identical prepared database/request fixtures.
inputs.basic_ticketinfo: Existing eight real travel templates including normal, fallback and upstream failure; same fixtures/body for both tools.
inputs.cart_first_creation: Additional paired absent-cart first GET / second GET, same customerId family; include as an explicit challenge, not a new query.
inputs.previously_refused: Execute original business entry despite TF planning refusal; fill itemId/start/terminal/batch bodies from actual fixture coordinates, not predicted provenance.
inputs.empty: Actual client JSON enumerates targets; explicit null is a target, empty wildcard has no element; N/A is counted per request.

baseline.first: MirrorTaint + disclosed adapter, original pinned propagation JAR
baseline.adapter_allowed: Configure/tag the declared boundaries using native APIs; export native tags and raw identities/versions/messages. Bind native IDs to observed source instances. No TF reconstruction, expected origins or business propagation formula in prediction.
baseline.calibration: Same-value distinct objects, repeated reads, overwritten versions, missing/ambiguous necessary evidence, constants and exception isolation.
baseline.other_tools: Phosphor and FlowDist follow after MirrorTaint task calibration; no capability claim from historical different-task results.

truth: Independent original-bytecode review and raw database/messages/object/call witnesses. Never use TF graph traversal or baseline labels to decide expected origins. Report oracle unavailable separately.
acceptance: For EVERY concrete target independently correct for baseline, TF selective must also be independently correct with no added false origins. Report the actual matched-instance set and all counterexamples; an empty/unrun baseline set cannot establish capability preservation.
versioning: Keep first results and all failures immutable. Any algorithm/model repair is a separately frozen version/regression; do not overwrite first gap table. Existing cost tables remain specific to their frozen versions.
